scope: Independent source review only; no application edits, compilation, tests, Worker, browser, network, SQL or state mutations performed.

harnessFindings.finding: Guarded continue validates the first URL only. A same-origin GET/HEAD redirect can issue an external request without another page.route guard.
harnessFindings.evidence: Installed Playwright primary API documentation: playwright-core/types/types.d.ts line 4314: The handler will only be called for the first url if the response is a redirect.
harnessFindings.fix: Replace remaining continue transport with same-origin GET/HEAD guarded fetch maxRedirects:0, reject redirect responses before fulfill, and add fake-route redirect groups. Preserve wrappers for every specific intercept.
harnessFindings.limits: No redirect was executed or observed; this is an unsupported claimed harness guarantee, not evidence of a product redirect or external request.

sourceConclusions: Catalog program body and OfferingIntent derive from the same accepted cohort; intent carries only bounded workspace, cohort and exact content reference metadata.
Explicit target compares accepted workspace, program, cohort and exact pinnedRef before resolving. Missing, repointed, mismatched and malformed explicit targets do not substitute another edition.
Own active enrollment retains precedence and exact saved pin, with a concise notice for conflicting intent; unavailable own content retains the existing support/export path.

Manual picker callback updates only navigation state/hash without scroll or main focus. LearningPage key excludes offering metadata so selector remains mounted; actual focus/history behavior still requires integrated browser acceptance.
No new API command, persistence, role, source registry or enrollment authority is introduced; enrollment remains a separate existing Start click with server authorization/capacity/CAS.
